handlers.name: ActorType76_77_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Gated actor-relative placement at PLAYER_Y = actor Y - WORLD_CAMERA_Y - 0x0B within 12 pixels, signed actor +0x1C horizontal offset into PLAYER_X, and interaction publication. Type 0x76 promotes to type 0x77 and chooses the 0x00124198 or 0x001241C8 continuation from PLAYER_WORLD_X relative to actor X.

handlers.name: ActorType74_75_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Gated actor-relative placement at PLAYER_Y = actor Y - WORLD_CAMERA_Y - 0x0B within 10 pixels. The type-0x74 left-side response installs movement 0x00120A42, clears actor +0x36, promotes to type 0x75, allocates ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_LEVEL_EXIT_CHILD, and copies source X/Y to the child.

handlers.name: ActorType6E_73_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Interaction-gated actor-relative placement at PLAYER_X = actor X - WORLD_CAMERA_X within 12 pixels and PLAYER_Y = actor Y - WORLD_CAMERA_Y + 0x10. It arms the player transition lock/gate and LEVEL_TIMER=4; when the prior LEVEL_TIMER is clear, it also selects PLAYER_ANIM_TERRAIN_ALIGNMENT_RESPONSE, clears the terrain response fields, and restores camera thresholds 0x00B0/0x0150.

boundary_checks.result: The three bodies terminate immediately before the next dispatch entries at 0x001AFA84, 0x001AFB36, and 0x001AFBF4; no promoted ranges overlap.

reachability_qualification: The three handlers are statically closed and connected to already recovered Type-0x76, level-exit Type-0x84, and Type-0x6E through Type-0x73 producer families. Their exact static behavior does not by itself establish live reachability on the retained Level 01 route; the existing producer and runtime audits remain authoritative for that question.
conclusion: The dense transition block is now canonicalized with exact dispatch mappings, placement windows, coordinate formulas, state latches, type promotion, child allocation, animation/movement roots, and non-overlapping internal boundaries.
